name: Long Lab
text: Single-nucleus RNA-seq analysis and tools for behavioral research in voles. The analysis spans quality control, background correction, doublet detection and integration; the behavior work includes comparing scorers and exploring automated tracking.

name: IISc: imaging and cell biology
text: Research at the Centre for Neuroscience, working with fluorescence and super-resolution imaging. I contributed data analysis to the Arl15 collaboration, which studied cargo transport and cell adhesion. The paper appeared in Traffic in 2025.

name: IIT Madras: comparative microbial genomics
kind: Project at IIT Madras in collaboration with NASA · 2023
text: Comparative analysis of bacterial genomes, including SNPs and indels, genome annotation and pangenome analysis. I also presented a poster. My contribution to the associated papers was primarily data analysis; both papers acknowledge my support with metagenomics analysis.

name: Fipronil sulfone and the gut microbiome
text: First-author molecular-simulation research on fipronil sulfone uptake by gut microbes, framed around a proposed connection to Parkinson’s disease risk. The computational study addresses molecular interactions; it does not establish disease causation.

name: BioMEMS and magnetic particle imaging
text: Berkeley BioMEMS project on microfluidic generation of nanoparticle-containing droplets for magnetic particle imaging. The team compared device geometry, flow conditions and surfactants, and tracked emulsion stability over time.

name: Speciale Invest
text: Research into biotech and deep-tech opportunities, including sourcing and founder diligence for an AI diagnostics startup.

name: Out of Syllabus
text: An education project that moved from an online-platform idea to an offline course as access became a constraint. I designed financial-literacy activities for students in grades 8–10, spoke with education practitioners and approached local schools. Games were intended to reveal how students applied the ideas. The project remains a work in progress.

name: Orforglipron marketing study
text: A team exercise in patient segmentation, positioning and market access for an oral GLP-1 candidate. The forecasts belong to the original course scenario.
